title: Navigate to the last result in a long layer list
steps: Inspect the layer-name search showing the first of 40 matching Waypoint layers.
Click Previous once, then inspect the workspace header, toolbar, and the area below the canvas.

video_guide.summary: Watch the layer-search panel when navigation reaches the last match. The workspace shifts upward, leaving a large unused band beneath the layers and canvas.

chapters.note: The Waypoint search is open and the workspace fills the available height.

chapters.label: Navigate to the last match with Previous

chapters.note: Navigation reaches 40 / 40; the page and canvas move upward and a dark band appears below the panel.
The misplaced panel and the large empty band remain visible.
